_meta.introduced_in: v10.497 governance batch, Stage B Wave 1

preamble.purpose: A2Z Blueprint MIS 360 is the bank's operating organism. It exists so every actor — MD to Teller — makes better decisions today than yesterday.
preamble.doctrine_provenance: 141+ consecutive lockstep batches; 412 audit gates currently enforce what this document captures
preamble.intent: Records what is enforced, not what is aspirational

I_living_organism.title: The system is a living organism
principles: Every major capability is an organ (Manager class, _engine.py module, or coherent module family) with declared responsibilities, dependencies, inputs, outputs
Organs have vitals via /api/v1/vitals/full, /organs, /regression
Organs have certification milestones (enterprise_discharge_ready → enterprise_360_compliance → olympic_certification → championship_readiness)
Organs interconnect through cross-organ event bus (utils/event_bus.py, utils/cross_organ_event_bus.py)
resilience_requirements: Uncertainty exposure (six phases, gate_v10489 through gate_v10494_FINAL)
violations: Code that doesn't belong to any organ
Code that violates an organ's contract
Code that creates a new organ without declaring its contract

II_single_source_of_truth.title: Single source of truth per concern
principles: Exactly one file/module DEFINES truth per domain; multiple may CONSUME
Source wins on conflict; consumer is reconciled
Canonical interface must be used; direct file reads from outside are violations
Multi-tenancy from day one: tenant identity in data/org_config.json only

canonical_interface_examples.forbidden_pattern: Parsing role strings directly in arbitrary modules
Hardcoded KPI ID lists in route bodies

III_canonical_role_governance.title: Canonical role governance
permitted_raw_role_strings: As display strings in user-facing UI (after canonical resolution)

IV_engine_purity.title: Engine purity
principles: Engines (_engine.py modules, Manager classes) are pure-compute with no transport awareness
Transports (Streamlit pages, FastAPI routes) translate user/HTTP requests to engine calls with no business logic
Same engine callable from Streamlit and FastAPI; identical results
Engine tests don't require either transport
violations: Business rules embedded in route handlers (e.g. if user.role == 'MD' instead of role_taxonomy call)
Engines using st.session_state or Request objects

audit_gate_contract.role: system's immune cells — continuous drift detection

V_authentication_authorization.title: Authentication and authorization

endpoint_auth_posture.rule: Every FastAPI endpoint except /api/health MUST declare an auth Depends
permitted_dependencies: Depends(require_role([...])) — specific role list required (v10.497 addition)

jwt_contract.extraction_priority: cookie wins over Authorization: Bearer header when both present
jwt_contract.transitional_note: JWT 'role' claim is descriptive string; canonical contract is to resolve via role_taxonomy at consumer

logout_contract_dual_action: Add token jti to blocklist with TTL = remaining lifetime

require_role_name_collision.location_a: utils/auth.py exports require_role(module, user) -> bool (alias of require_access)
require_role_name_collision.location_b: utils/auth_jwt.py exports require_role(roles: list[str]) FastAPI Depends factory

password_doctrine.v003_fix: bcrypt hash; new accounts get bcrypt; existing SHA-256 migrate transparently on successful login via UserManager.authenticate

VI_data_dictionary_discipline.title: Data dictionary discipline
principles: Every file in data/ has a declared owner
Where data/_schemas/ entry exists, it is canonical for shape
Where no schema exists, consuming module parsing is de facto contract (open item)
VI_data_dictionary_discipline.backup_retention: Pattern: data/_v10XXX_backups/; enforced by /api/v1/backup-retention/audit + apply; gitignored

VII_frontend_governance.title: Frontend governance
principles: Single component system: shadcn/ui (effective v10.497 P0)
No parallel component architectures
Tokens flow from frontend/web/src/lib/tokens.ts (semantic hex, single source)
Brand colors (--brand-*) HEX, tenant-injected at runtime by BrandingProvider
shadcn theme variables (--primary etc.) HSL-component projections of tokens.ts
Tailwind config wraps with hsl(var(--token) / <alpha-value>)
Role-driven rendering via useRole() hook (Phase 2 v10.497), never direct role-string comparisons
a2z_extensions_codified: StatCard composition over shadcn Card (KPI tile pattern)
enforcement_gates: G382 all primitives exist + no hardcoded hex in components

VIII_audit_trail_and_telemetry.title: Audit trail and telemetry
principles: Every state-changing API operation MUST emit _audit() event (single canonical emitter, utils/api.py line 170)
Event naming: API_<DOMAIN>_<ACTION>
Read-only operations need not emit audit events
Operations that change state without auditing are violations

IX_ai_ml_governance.title: AI and ML governance
principles: Models registered before deployment (utils/mlops_model_registry.py)
Each has model card (utils/mlops_model_card_composer.py)
Predictions emit adjudication log entries (utils/mlops_adjudication_log.py)
Rollouts controlled by AB harness (utils/mlops_ab_harness.py)
Retraining only via retraining scheduler (utils/mlops_retraining_scheduler.py)
Models making decisions about humans require explainability + fairness testing
Accuracy drift triggers gate_anti_drift_completion_floor

two_streams.master_prompt: v5.XX — current v5.40, will become v5.41 with this governance batch

carried_principles.principle: Discovered prior work → honor not destroy
Phantom audit contracts → make real or remove

XII_constitutional_amendments.title: Constitutional amendments
amendment_process: Author change in feature branch (e.g. feature/governance-constitution)
Merge develop → main with vX.YYY-constitutional tag
XII_constitutional_amendments.drift_detection: gate_canonical_truth_registry_sync (Stage C) — drift between articles here and gates in scripts/audit.py is itself a violation
